source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 4 May 1939, p. 4 ("Newtownards Board of Guardians and Rural Council: nominations")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Votes from the Belfast News-Letter (3 June 1939, p. 3); nominations and unopposed returns from the Belfast Telegraph (4 May 1939, p. 4).

note: Triennial election of the Newtownards Rural District Council, polled at the end of May 1939. Only Ballywalter was contested; the retiring member was defeated. Filed on 1939-06-01, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1939-05-31 (verification 5 Nov 2026). The source list (Belfast Telegraph, 4 May 1939, p. 4) is headed "nominations ... for the Newtownards Board of Guardians and Rural Council" and also includes the Newtownards urban wards and Donaghadee Urban (two members); these urban divisions elected guardians only, not rural district councillors, so they are not recorded here. Nominated unopposed. Returned unopposed.
